responsibility: Implements the `SessionDiagnostic` derive macro, turning annotated diagnostic structs into code that constructs and emits rustc session diagnostics. It parses crate-specific struct and field attributes for diagnostic kind, error code, fluent slug, spans, labels, notes, helps, and suggestions, validates that the annotated fields have compatible types and references, and generates the formatting and builder calls that map struct data into `rustc_errors` diagnostics.
